content: this is a summary of a legal case that took place in the klaipeda district court the case involves a divorce and the division of property between the parties the applicant is seeking a divorce requesting to retain their surname establish the residence of their minor children arrange access to them and receive maintenance payments from the defendant they also want the division of property acquired during the marriage and compensation for a lower share of the property the defendant disagrees with some of the claims and argues that the dissolution of the marriage was not their fault they accept the division of property proposed by the applicant but request a forensic experts report to establish the market value of the property the court examines the materials presented by both parties and determines the community property of the spouses the court awards the majority of the property to the applicant and orders the defendant to pay compensation the court also addresses the division of a motorcycle and orders the defendant to reimburse the applicant for half of its value the court upholds the applicants application for divorce and divides the property accordingly
